decisions.name: typed-normalize
decisions.rationale: Full-extraction typed normalize. Chunk: 6000 chars, overlap: 500. Coverage threshold: 70%. RetryLoop max 3.
known_limits: Coverage metric is char-count based, not semantic — LLM reformatting can reduce ratio
OCR-degraded sources may have low coverage due to garbled text
switch_conditions: Structured input formats (LaTeX, structured DOCX) could use rule-based classification
